<div class="section-intro">
This section is the stable catalogue of my active research programmes and focused analytical projects. The website documents the scientific question, scope, methods, status, and outputs of each project; code, data, manuscripts, and reusable workflows remain in their canonical repositories when those repositories are public and verified.
</div>

## Featured projects

<div class="home-grid">
<div class="home-card">
<div class="kicker">Active · Research programme</div>

### [Multidimensional state of the north-central Peruvian anchovy stock](anchovy-stock-state/)

Integrating population magnitude, condition, reproduction, demographic structure, spatial distribution, and environmental and fishing pressures.
</div>

<div class="home-card">
<div class="kicker">Active · Manuscript project</div>

### [Selectivity and demographic change in the anchovy fishery](anchovy-selectivity/)

Evaluating long-term and seasonal changes in length selectivity, selection range, juvenile incidence, and demographic structure.
</div>

<div class="home-card">
<div class="kicker">Active · Manuscript programme</div>

### [Spatio-temporal patterns of the Peruvian tuna purse-seine fishery](tuna-fishery/)

Characterizing catch, effort, operational behaviour, fishing modes, species composition, standardized CPUE, and environmental associations.
</div>
</div>

## Repository policy

A project page is not a duplicate of its GitHub repository. A repository link is displayed only when a canonical project repository has been verified. Broader programmes may link to several paper, software, data, or training repositories as those components are audited.
